titre: Assurance des accidents du travail aux États-Unis
sous_titre: Ratio combiné de l'ensemble des assureurs privés américains, en %, de 2023 à 2025

series.nom: Ratio combiné de la branche accidents du travail

2023.texte: in 2024, U.S. workers' compensation net premium decreased 3% from 2023, with a combined ratio of 86, the same as in 2023

2024.texte: The 2024 calendar year combined ratio of 86% represents a 14-point underwriting gain, reflecting significant profitability for carriers

2025.texte: The calendar year 2025 combined ratio for workers' compensation is 91 (compared with 86 the prior year)
